hooks.command: jq -r '(.tool_response.stdout // "") + "\n" + (.tool_response.stderr // "")' | grep -q 'Hugo version mismatch' && make bump-hugo-ci && git add .github/workflows/deploy.yml .github/workflows/preview.yml Makefile && git commit -m 'chore(ci): align Hugo CI version with local' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUseFailure","additionalContext":"Hugo version mismatch fixed — CI files aligned to local Hugo version. Retry git push."}}'
